# Zakaria Fadli

> Embedded software engineer in Paris, currently working on embedded toolchains at AdaCore (cross-compilers, binary tools and run-times, with RISC-V among the targets).

Before AdaCore, Zakaria built firmware for connected electrical devices (wireless, Zigbee) at Netatmo and Legrand group, from 2017 to 2025. He studied at ENSEEIHT and Georgia Institute of Technology.

Contact: https://zakariafadli.com/contact/ · GitHub: https://github.com/zakaria1193
